name: notification
title: Notification
description: Shared notification cards with tone, avatar, actions and timed dismissal. A scoped provider presents a list or animated stack, with queue limits, paused timers, keyboard navigation and updates for pending operations.
example:
<NotificationProvider layout="stack" maxVisible={3} position="bottom-right">
  <Workspace />
</NotificationProvider>

// Use layout="list" for individually visible cards (the default).
// Inside Workspace:
const notifications = useNotification();
notifications.notify({
  title: "Changes saved",
  description: "Your preferences are up to date.",
  tone: "success",
});
